title: Angler Fishing
description: This is an option add-on mod to give a little spice to your fishing activities! Exclusive to The Pen MC!
body:
# AnglerXP

AnglerXP is a **client-side fishing progression layer** for The Pen (play.thepen-mc.net). It quietly watches what you reel in and turns it into levels, a collection book, badges, milestone titles, unlockable HUD themes, and a prestige system — purely as a personal overlay.

It is **cosmetic and informational only**. It does not change what the server gives you, does not automate fishing, and does not send any data anywhere — all progress is saved locally on your own machine.

## What it does

- **Tracks every catch.** Detects fish as they enter your inventory and identifies all 71 of The Pen's species, coloured by rarity (Common → Legendary).
- **Earns you XP and levels** with a small streak bonus for back-to-back catches.
- **Collection book** (press `J`): every species you've caught, sorted by count, with lifetime totals, best streak, and total time spent fishing.
- **Badges** per species — Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond — with thresholds that scale by rarity, so commons are a long grind and rare fish badge up sooner.
- **Milestone titles** from Novice up to Legendary Angler as you level.
- **HUD themes** unlocked by level (Ocean, Forest, Sunset, Midnight, Prestige Gold). Cycle them with the arrow keys in the collection screen. A theme recolours the fishing HUD, the XP bar, and your in-game interfaces.
- **Prestige** at level 75: a full rebirth that wipes your progress in exchange for a prestige rank shown on your title (e.g. `Master Angler ✦II`), three exclusive prestige-only themes (Abyssal, Crimson, Void), and a permanent **Legacy viewer** so you can look back on every past life.
- **Celebration toasts** for new discoveries, badge tier-ups, level-ups, and treasure catches.

By default the mod stays completely out of the way: fresh players (and each fresh prestige) see plain vanilla Minecraft until they choose a theme.

## Why download it

If you fish on The Pen, AnglerXP gives the grind structure and goals — something to chase beyond the raw catch — without touching the actual game. It's a personal scoreboard and a way to make your HUD your own.

## Before you download — please read

- **Made for The Pen.** The fish list and rarities are specific to that server's custom fishing system, so the mod has little use anywhere else.
- **Client-side only.** Install it on your own client; it is not a server mod and gives no gameplay advantage to install.
- **No data leaves your PC.** Progress is stored locally in `config/anglerxp.json`.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.10
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

## Configuration

Options live in `config/anglerxp.json`:

- `replaceXpBar` — recolour the vanilla XP bar and level to your theme (default: on)
- `tintInterfaces` — apply the theme tint to all GUI screens (default: on)
- `selectedTheme` — your active HUD theme
